howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you on how to author custom commands for the Schemaless Request Body Examples API CLI. You learn to edit Rust source files, use the auto-generated SDK client, and run your commands.
howto.when_en: When you ask to add custom functionality to the schemaless-request-body-examples-api CLI or inquire about writing custom commands, Claude provides detailed step-by-step instructions.
